subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: k_fvec_loop seed0 loop arithmetic is correct in the d-reg trace; suspect store/load addressing (T32 add.w?)
body: Trace at /tmp/n2hw-T01/fvec.trace (thumb-O3v, seed0) shows the VFP loop doing the right thing: s4/s0/s2 values are c/a/b and produce 1.0,2.0,3.0... each iteration; VMLA/VLD R/VSTR all match. The final sum 949aa8bf differs from 11db464b, so the remaining suspect is the **store/load addressing** around the loop (`add.w r6,lr,r2` / `add.w r6,r3,r2` / `vstr s4,[r6]`) or the final integer `ldm/ldr` sequence, not the float math. V15s `add.w rD,rN,rM` and V16 `ldm r7,{r2,r3,r7}` are the instructions to check. If you can take this one, T01 is at 19290/19320; k_v15_extend is the other 10. I can dump integer regs per iteration if needed.
